200.description:
Public case status record of a district-court case identified by its 16-character CNR (ep-view-cnr-history, cnr_status/viewCNRHistory). No CAPTCHA is involved: the portal answers this call with the full record once a session is open. Returns the court, case type, filing/registration/e-filing numbers and dates, the status block (first hearing, next hearing or decision date, case stage or nature of disposal, court number and judge; every row is also kept verbatim in status_fields), petitioners and respondents with their advocates, acts and sections, the hearing history and the interim and final order rows. Dates are kept exactly as the portal prints them (dd-mm-yyyy in tables, '02nd January 2024' in the status block). An unknown CNR is not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `acts` | object[] |  |
| `case_stage` | string | Pending cases only, e.g. 'Pre-Charge Evidence'. |
| `case_status` | string | Disposed cases print 'Case disposed'; pending cases have no such row (null). |
| `case_type` | string | '<short> - <long>' as printed, e.g. 'Misc DJ - MISC. CASES FOR DJ and ADJ'. |
| `cnr` | string | The CNR as the portal prints it (upper case). |
| `court_name` | string | Court establishment heading, e.g. 'District and Sessions Judge,New Delhi, PHC'. |
| `court_number_and_judge` | string | e.g. '52-District Judge-01'. |
| `decision_date` | string | Disposed cases only. |
| `disposed` | boolean | true when the status block carries a Decision Date or a 'disposed' Case Status. |
| `efiling_date` | string | null when the portal prints '-'. |
| `efiling_number` | string | null when the portal prints the row blank. |
| `filing_date` | string | dd-mm-yyyy as printed. |
| `filing_number` | string |  |
| `final_orders` | object[] | Empty for pending cases. |
| `first_hearing_date` | string | As printed in the status block, e.g. '02nd January 2024'. |
| `history` | object[] |  |
| `interim_orders` | object[] |  |
| `nature_of_disposal` | string | Disposed cases only, e.g. 'Uncontested--DISPOSED'. |
| `next_hearing_date` | string | Pending cases only. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `petitioners` | object[] |  |
| `registration_date` | string | dd-mm-yyyy as printed. |
| `registration_number` | string |  |
| `respondents` | object[] |  |
| `source_url` | string | The portal's CNR search page; the record itself is only reachable through the session-bound POST. |
| `status_fields` | object[] | Every row of the status block verbatim, in page order. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

value.case_type: Misc DJ - MISC. CASES FOR DJ and ADJ
value.court_name: District and Sessions Judge,New Delhi, PHC
